title: Don't trim highlight snippet if number_of_fragments is 0 #101803

timeline.body:
Don't trim highlight snippet if number_of_fragments is 0

Closes  #101803
Does it make sense to add context in this test class to this new argument used ?

reply.body: I could, but wouldn't going the class `CustomPassageFormatter` provide that context? I'm assuming you're suggesting adding context that the new parameter is for `numberOfFragments`? Correct me if I am wrong in my understanding your suggestion.

timeline.body: @mayya-sharipova would you be able to help with reviewing this PR?
Pinging @elastic/es-search (Team:Search)

@yashdamani Thank you for your contribution. The approach makes sense to me.


Please add rest tests into `rest-api-spec/src/yamlRestTest/resources/rest-api-spec/test/search.highlight` for the change. Here is the guidance about [YAML rest tests](https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/blob/main/TESTING.asciidoc#testing-the-rest-layer).
I will let @mayya-sharipova do a full review, but either we should have `null` checks, or this shouldn't be a boxed type and should just be `int`

reply.body: Makes sense, `numberOfFragments` isn't expected have a `null` value, so I guess it's better to switch it to a `int` rather than doing null checks. Thanks for pointing it out! @benwtrent

timeline.body: @mayya-sharipova I've added the rest test file for the change. I'm not sure the about preceding number in the naming convention for the .yml files. I've added the case for `number_of_fragments > 0` and `number_of_fragments = 0`. Is a default case (where the param `number_of_fragments` isn't mentioned) also required? Also, I've used the same input as the original issue linked with this PR.

@yashdamani  Great work so far. The PR is almost ready. 

A small comment: let's do this setup, which means skip this test for nodes than run version < 8.14

```
setup:
  - skip:
      version: ' - 8.13.99'
      reason: 'no trimming highlight snippets when number_of_fragments is 0 was introduced  in 8.14'
```

reply.body: Thank you! Made all the changes as suggested.

timeline.message: added tests to CustomPassageFormatterTests to include different values of numberOfFragments
timeline.author: yashdamani

timeline.body: @mayya-sharipova there were errors in `CustomPassageFormatterTests` as well. I've made changes to now include tests for different values of `numberOfFragments`.  Would [this](https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/106306/commits/646ca23fda9ef3e6cd01e791885d770d464932d0) be the right approach to modify the tests? If yes, then I'll use the same approach for `CustomUnifiedHighlighterTests` as well, which failed in the build.
@yashdamani Please don't force push changes while PR is under review, as it is difficult to see the changes from the previous review.

I think we don't need to modify this test at all. This test is designed when there are 3 passages, which will not happen if number_of_fragments is 0. The only modification you can do is to add a `3` as a number of fragments. ```java CustomPassageFormatter passageFormatter = new CustomPassageFormatter("", "", new DefaultEncoder(), 3); ```

reply.body: Got it. I was under the impression that both the testcases (where `numberOfFragments` is 0 and > 0) need to be written.
